mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, file_id, file_name, mime_type, size_bytes, visibility, owner_module, owner_ref_type, owner_ref_id, folder_path, space, folder_id, backend_type, backend_config_id, backend_object_key, upload_state, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_file WHERE upload_state = 'uploading' AND uploaded_at < #{threshold} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY uploaded_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM sys_file f WHERE f.visibility = 'file-center' AND f.space = #{space} AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND f.uploaded_by = #{uploadedBy} AND (f.folder_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_file_folder d WHERE d.id = f.folder_id AND d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY f.deleted_at DESC
SELECT FROM sys_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_file WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND folder_id IN #{i}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file SET space = #{space}, folder_id = #{folderId}, updated_at = now() WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_file SET space = #{space}, folder_id = #{folderId}, file_name = #{fileName}, updated_at = now() WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_file SET deleted_at = NULL, folder_id = #{folderId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM sys_file WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND upload_state = 'active'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS file_count, COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) AS total_bytes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_at < #{expiringThreshold} AND deleted_at >= #{overdueThreshold}) AS expiring_soon_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_at < #{overdueThreshold}) AS overdue_count FROM sys_file WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL
